symptom: A lint rule printing `page.title` alternates between translations (`Customer history` / `Klant historie`) across catalog rebuilds of an unchanged project, and on a project whose default language is nl_NL reports the en_US text (mendixlabs/mxcli#1262)
cause: buildPages ranged over pg.Title.Translations and kept the first entry; Go map order is random, so pages_data.Title was whatever language came first
insight: Every catalog column filled from a Texts$Text must go through pickTranslation(map, b.defaultLanguage()) — grep `range .*Translations` in mdl/catalog. A two-language map can look stable for ten builds on one machine; the unit test uses 22 languages so a map-order pick fails on the first build. The schema version must be bumped too, or a cached catalog keeps the old title
